name: Destination Thailand Visa (DTV)

requirement_groups.name: Workcation (remote work for a foreign-registered employer)

requirements.blocker_text: Requires employment by, or freelance contracts with, a company or clients registered outside Thailand, plus a professional portfolio evidencing digital-nomad status -- working for Thai companies or Thai clients is not covered and remains subject to Non-B/work permit rules instead.
requirements.fix_path: Confirm the employing or contracting entity is genuinely foreign-registered and compile a professional portfolio.

value.note: MYR 65,000 accepted as an alternative for applicants documenting funds in Malaysian Ringgit.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires bank statements from the preceding 3 months showing a minimum balance of THB 500,000 (or MYR 65,000).
requirements.fix_path: Document at least THB 500,000 in available funds over a 3-month statement history.

requirements.blocker_text: Covers participants in Muay Thai training, Thai culinary arts courses, medical treatment, professional seminars, or artistic/cultural festivals, evidenced by an acceptance or appointment letter from the relevant institution -- a distinct qualifying basis from remote employment, aimed at Thai cultural and soft-power activities specifically.
requirements.fix_path: Enrol in or secure participation confirmation for a qualifying Thai soft-power activity.

evidence_required.document: Employment/freelance contract with a foreign-registered entity and professional portfolio, or acceptance/appointment letter for a qualifying soft-power activity
3 months' bank statements showing THB 500,000 (or MYR 65,000) minimum balance
Proof of prolonged residence in Thailand of at least 6 months (rental/lease agreement) for certain applicant categories, plus 6 months' salary/income documentation

outcome.duration_length: 5 years multiple-entry, up to 180 days per entry, extendable once per entry for a further 180 days at an immigration office
outcome.physical_presence_requirement: must exit and re-enter Thailand every ~180 days to maintain status; DTV years do not count toward the LTR visa or Thai Permanent Residency

sources.title: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Thailand (mfa.go.th) -- Destination Thailand Visa (DTV) document checklist

notes: STATUS UPGRADED from draft to published in this pass: the prior draft's two tier-3 sources (issacompass.com, mbmg-group.com) are now backed by a direct fetch of the Thai Ministry of Foreign Affairs' own official checklist document, which independently confirms the THB 500,000 funds threshold and the three-category structure (Workcation, Soft Power, and -- newly documented here -- Dependents). NEW DETAIL not in the prior draft: the checklist also accepts MYR 65,000 as an alternative currency for the funds requirement, and requires 'proof of prolonged residence in Thailand for at least 6 months' plus 6 months' salary documentation for certain applicant categories -- the checklist's phrasing on exactly which categories this applies to was not fully disambiguated in this pass. STRUCTURAL FINDING retained from the prior draft, not re-litigated here: the DTV's legal status for remote work occupies a genuine grey area -- it authorises the stay but does not explicitly grant formal work permission the way a work permit does, since Thailand's Foreign Business Act and Alien Employment Act frameworks were not written with remote/foreign-employer work in mind. leads_to_pr and leads_to_citizenship remain false, and the 180-day exit/re-entry cycle remains the defining maintenance requirement, both unchanged from the prior draft's findings and not contradicted by the tier-1 document fetched in this pass.
